newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola falls on commercials, commission sales.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola falls on commercials, commission sales.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended lower on commercial and commission selling, traders said.

"Cargill sold 800 Jan and March, commission houses and locals sold too," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread at $4, Mar-May $2, Nov-Mar $6. November crush margin ended at -37.39. Volume was 8,060 lots, or 161,200 tonnes, with 250 hedge lots.
Japan bought 10,000-15,000 tonnes canola, sources said.
November canola fell $1.10 to $399.10, January lost $2.50 to $403.40. November flax lost $1 to $365. Nov-Jan at $2.50.
November barley up $0.10 to $145 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold 100, February rose $0.10 to $147.50 with AWP buying. Nov May spread at $4, Nov-Feb $2.30, Feb-Mar $5. Volume was 1,100.
October feed wheat lost $0.50 to $177.50, December lost $1.30 to $168.20 with Cargill selling, AWP bought May down $0.80 at $167. Dec-Mar spread at $2. Volume was 1,255 lots.
"There's a debate in the pit whether they'll get all of the crop off in Alberta now or next spring," a trader said.
Cargill bought five December oats up US$0.50 at US$131. LFG sold four December feed peas down US$1 to US$198.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
